bio: I build backend systems in Go, Python, and TypeScript mostly the unglamorous work of making things fast, reliable, and simple enough to ship.
Software engineer by day. Lately a lot of my curiosity has gone toward AI and the systems behind it, but I'm happiest when something I built is actually being used.
creativeBio: I like simple, sleek work that isn't trying too hard. Nothing overcomplicated, but the kind that sticks. I also ramble about movies, views, and random things that felt worth remembering.
